subject: science
concept: Real-world multi-step problems connecting atomic structure, cell biology, and basic chemical bonding, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student works through a realistic scenario connecting atomic-level, cellular-level, and molecular concepts
exercise.pictorial: Student builds a diagram connecting a described phenomenon across these levels
exercise.abstract: Student explains a real-world phenomenon by connecting concepts from atomic structure, cell biology, and bonding

misconception_flags: explains the phenomenon at only one level (e.g. cellular) without connecting it to the atomic or molecular level

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
